Parent epic: bd-01KY1BVCQVAYT48NJEGR7M2CP6

Explore constrained and probabilistic canonical models only through the typed variational/ModelSpec follow-on architecture. Candidate constraints include nonnegative, simplex, sparse/group, smooth, and structured feature frames; probabilistic variants must state a generative model, likelihood, identifiability, uncertainty target, and fold-local fitting contract. Do not bolt options onto CanonicalEffectProblem or duplicate solvers. Acceptance begins with a frozen estimand and lowering decision, then independent simulation/oracle evidence, explicit symmetry/gauge semantics, leakage-safe tuning/inference, and JVM/Scala.js support or a documented platform boundary.
set.title: One-shot canonical models: constrained and probabilistic extensions
